item.title: Version 1.0.32
item.description:
feat: blocked-apps list is now seamless across Mac + web

Backend persists each session's blocked_bundle_ids on the row.  Mac
+ web both render the server-provided list (or fall back to the local
profile if the field is empty, for pre-1.0.32 sessions).  No matter
where the flip was started, every client now shows the exact apps
that are currently hidden on your iPhone.
